# Vendor Support Contracts

Tags: #team #vendors

## AWS Support

We hold AWS Business Support, giving 1-hour response for production-impaired cases. Open cases from the console in the affected account; only the platform admin permission set can create them.

## Other Vendors

PagerDuty and GitHub support is through their web portals with 4-hour response on our plans. Contract renewals fall in March (PagerDuty) and August (GitHub). The owner for each renewal is the engineering manager.
